title: fix(pm): H4 prose and the pm:blocked readings release a PR target on merge, never on close
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D9bpbnMYZSP81qLAuSGbxeh)_

Fixes #27989

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`Blocked-by:` 目标是 PR 时,三处读器从「关闭即放」改为「合并才放」:H4 散文半边把「关而未合并」单独成桶、渲染 `CLOSED UNMERGED`、不再说「due back in pm:queue」;SKILL.md 的 `pm:blocked` 行改为「关单(PR 则合并,关而未合并不放)时放回」;platform-readings.md 改为 PR 判合并走 `pull_request_read`/REST,不再点名 `issue_read`。
- 为什么改:解析器已给废弃 PR 打 `unmerged: true`,但 H4 散文子句仍按 `state === 'closed'` 分桶,把卡在废弃 PR 上的卡报成「条件已满足、该回队」;MCP `issue_read` 实测分不出合并与废弃(记录 6516593752)。
- 风险与回滚:只有 report-only 行文与规则文本,无新门禁、无标签写入;两处规则行各自行数持平(319/319、458/458),字节在天花板内。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个 commit。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` `proseBlockerClause`(新 docblock 段落与 `abandoned` 桶)→ 9 个 `H4 prose PR:` 钉子 → 两行规则文本 diff。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test && pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:无。本 PR 欠契约复核(席位以 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 出记录),落地档以 `GOVERNED_SURFACES` 登记为准(`--branch` 预读:Tier S,`.claude/**` ×2),席位落地。

## What changes

After the unlock sweep learned that a `Blocked-by:` line can name a PR, and that a PR target releases on **merged**, three readers still spoke of a PR target as "closed". Card items 1–3; items 4 and 5 are read below.

**Item 1 — `proseBlockerClause` (H4 prose half), `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`.** The resolver `blockerResolutionFromRow` already keeps `state: 'closed'` for an abandoned PR and marks it `unmerged: true`, but the clause bucketed every `closed` row as a satisfied condition and told the seat the card was "due back in `pm:queue`" — for a prose-named PR that closed without merging, a release that never happened. Now:

- `namedProseCandidates` renders such a row as `` `#N` CLOSED UNMERGED (closed_at) ``.
- The verdict has an `abandoned` bucket. A merged PR (closed, no mark) still reads "ALREADY CLOSED … due back in `pm:queue`" — the released direction is unchanged. All-abandoned reads "closed UNMERGED — an abandoned attempt releases nothing … the block still stands; the target wants re-pointing". Mixed readings count only merges/issue closes as expired, and an abandoned close beside an open target no longer claims "They all still read OPEN".
- Nine `H4 prose PR:` pins drive the measured `GET /issues/N` shapes (#27888 merged, #27296 closed unmerged, the same rows H19's battery pins) through the sweep's own projection into the clause. Report-only: H4 writes no label, and the clause still ends with "fix it by writing the `Blocked-by: #N` line".

**Item 2 — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, the `pm:blocked` status row.** 「#N 关闭时由解锁扫描或 `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` 刷新放回」 → 「#N 关单(PR 则合并,关而未合并不放)时由解锁扫描或 `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` 放回」, agreeing with `state-machine.md` 「合并才放,关而未合并 ⛔ 不放」. In-row, 319 lines kept. The row sits at the file's `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` ceiling (341), so three words were tightened in the same row to pay for the new clause: 「刷新放回」→「放回」, 「工已完、PR 被外部门禁卡住的」→「工已完而被门禁卡住的」, 「正文或线程行首」→「双通道行首」 (the term the hold/blocked line below already uses), 「挂本态直至其」→「直至其」. No rule was dropped.

**Item 3 — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`.** The unlock-scan line named `issue_read` + `merged_at`; measurement 6516593752 shows MCP `issue_read` on a PR number answers `state: "closed"` with no `pull_request` key, so it cannot tell a merge from an abandonment. The line now reads 「解锁扫描 `list_issues` 列卡、逐目标直读,⛔ 不加常设评论读;PR 合并走 `pull_request_read`/REST。」 — exactly 120 bytes, the `MAX_LINE_BYTES` ceiling, which is why the REST read is named without its `merged_at` field and `issue_read` is excluded by omission rather than by a ⛔ clause. 458 lines kept.

**Item 4 — read, not edited.** Triage 6516946612 rules: no new gate; triage's `unlock` scan already lists a closed-unmerged PR target as not released; at most the `pm:blocked` row says so. The row now says 「关而未合并不放」; `state-machine.md` is untouched and H26 is not extended.

**Item 5 — H28 wording.** Not touched: the diff does not reach H28.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` → 5098 cases pass (was 5089).
- Ablation, three legs, each restored to the committed file afterwards (`git diff` empty): (A) the `closed` bucket counts unmerged rows again → 6 of the new pins red; (B) the render drops the `UNMERGED` word → 1 red; (C) the all-abandoned branch removed → 1 red. The two merged-PR pins pin the direction that was already right and are not reachable by an ablation of this diff.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` → 105 files clean. `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` → green (SKILL.md row 341/341, platform-readings line 120/120). `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → green.
- Gate families from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --changed`: 58 commands, all run serially on the committed head 45763c74 in a fresh worktree after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and the `@objectstack/lint...` build, each exit code captured before any pipe; all 58 exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation: 58 derived, 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0); the derivation recomputed after the commit is the same 58.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-vo8914` → governed `.claude/**` ×2, Tier S; `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` not on the register.
- The project-context step "assign and request a review from the requester at PR creation" was not performed: SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉 says 「`pr_create` 不请不派」; the hand-off is the seat's after ACCEPT.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes on the touched script.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (nothing publishes; `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
